reviews.text: Quality Roofing repaired my roof about 8 years ago they also helped me get gutters. They did interior painting as well as painting the outside of the house. The were super easy to work with made my experience enjoyable. They were very professional, courteous and on time. There work was top knotch! I would recommend them to anyone needing a roof the are the best!
reviews.author: Tina Hefner

reviews.text: From the top to the bottom, just a great company. James is a  huge advocates for his clients, and he understand the way the insurance adjusters work. He fight hard to get you everything you need to make your new roof right. I couldn't be happier with the experience he has gave our clients. James and his team  A+! I highly recommend Quality Roofing & Painting.
reviews.author: karen dimas

reviews.text: Awesome roofer and painter of tremendous integrity. I just had a roof replaced and Quality Roofing was there for me every part of the way from insurance adjustment to repairs to depreciation recovery. I would recommend Quality Roofing to my mother or best friend knowing they would receive tremendous value and professional work!
reviews.author: Craig Carlson

reviews.text: Quality Roofing was very helpful, informative and did a professional job. They also cleaned up everything when they were done which was a welcome site couldn’t ask for a better job. Would recommend them to anyone that needs a roof! They also did work inside the home painting and it was also a professional job and cleaned up when done. And they stained my fence and now it looks almost new they do a exceptionally great job!!
reviews.author: Tina Hefner

reviews.text:
Quality Roofing and Painting did a HORRIBLE job on my house one year ago. They came to replace the roof. Did the job and on the next rain, we has a problem with leakage. Called Quality Roofing and Mr. James said he would stop by and check . Came almost two weeks after  he schedule date. DID NOT FIXED. Next rain same problem and he send someone which DID NOT FIXED and put a UGLY patch on my new roof. So  almost six months after, I'm still dont have my problem solved. GOING TO COURT TO RESOLVE.
If you want a good contractor AVOID QUALITY ROOFING .
reviews.author: gabriel campos

reviews.text: I hired a small contractor.  He was supposed to tarp my roof but failed to do so and there was a huge rainstorm that caused internal damage.  After going back and forth with the insurance company, I fired him.  I had seen Quality Roofing's truck next door and down the street and I finally contacted the familiar face I'd seen many times.  Ken Richards stopped by (after I flagged him down) and assessed the external and internal damage and said his company could take care of it all.  He was diligent, called or text me constantly and even checked to make sure there wasn't any additional damage after the roof had been tarped. He was visible and available at all times.  He even fixed my fence himself when the timeline was getting extended!  Not to mention he tolerated my dog latching onto him.  I am 100% satisfied and would recommend this company to anyone in need of someone who is not shifty and follows through.  Gei Manning, Fossil Hills Estates
reviews.author: Gei Manning

reviews.text: James and his team did an amazing job! He helped me pick my roof color by bring the samples out and putting them on my roof. They cleaned up really good! I would definitely use them again!
reviews.author: Laurie Thomas

reviews.text: From start to finish they did everything they said they would ,the whole process went a lot easier than I thought. They explained the insurance summary to me And made me feel  comfortable and confident in my decisions, so glad they where reffered to me. My house looks great
reviews.author: Kathy Adams

data.summary: Mixed signals with concerning patterns. Google reviews appear potentially manipulated with clustered 5-star reviews and minimal criticism, while Yelp shows much lower ratings. The single detailed 1-star complaint on Google reveals serious warranty/service issues that align with the poor Yelp rating. BBB accreditation is positive but doesn't reflect customer experience quality.
fake_signals: Multiple 5-star Google reviews posted around the same time (5 years ago)
Repetitive language in positive reviews ('professional', 'clean up')
Lack of specific details in some positive reviews
No negative reviews on Google except one from 8 years ago
Suspiciously perfect 5-star pattern on Google with minimal mid-range ratings

negative_evidence: Called about leak, came two weeks late, DID NOT FIXED
Sent someone who DID NOT FIXED and put UGLY patch
Six months later problem not solved

authentic_signals: Specific complaint details in 1-star review (leakage, patch, court)
Some positive reviews mention specific names (James, Ken Richards)
Varied project types mentioned (roofing, painting, gutters, staining)
BBB shows legitimate business history with A+ rating
data.discrepancy_explanation: Significant discrepancy between Google (4.7) and Yelp (2.6) ratings. Google reviews are overwhelmingly positive with 7 of 8 being 5-star, while Yelp shows a much lower average. This suggests potential review manipulation on Google or different customer bases, but the stark contrast is a red flag.
